svg.title: Productize the Workflow, Not the Promise
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-fixed-scope-delivery; chart type: process_flow; title: Productize the Workflow, Not the Promise; subtitle: Five stages connect authorized intake to a bounded support retainer.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The Conservative and Base delivery pod has two full-time employees and three contractors; contractors are people, not three additional full-time equivalents. Recognized revenue comprises implementation fees and support retainers.; caption: Client intake workflows, deployment checklists, and usage and quality monitoring reduce repeated coordination. Client sales, savings, and transaction volume remain outside agency revenue.; stages: label: Qualify one workflow; value: Name the owner, inputs, outputs, and exception queue; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Capture the workflow in a structured intake form. Inspect representative redacted examples and reject projects whose buyer cannot define an acceptance test.; label: Contract a bounded sprint; value: Price one deliverable with explicit change rules; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Specify supported systems, transaction limits, acceptance criteria, data-processing terms, and IP rights. Quote additional connectors and workflow branches as separately priced changes.; label: Build against fixtures; value: Implement with client-owned, least-privilege service accounts; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Use GitHub for versioned code and n8n or a Python worker for orchestration. Keep credentials outside prompts; test retrieval boundaries, malformed inputs, and retry idempotency with synthetic fixtures.; label: Evaluate and deploy; value: Require evidence before enabling production writes; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Run a held-out evaluation set, record failure categories, and rehearse rollback. The client owner accepts the bounded workflow; consequential outputs retain human review.; label: Operate within limits; value: Monitor usage, quality, incidents, and renewal evidence; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Track cost per completed task, exception rate, and review workload. Define included support hours, response windows, usage ceilings, and overage pricing before the retainer begins.
